measurement: Fresh pose with no previous lighting, visibility, transfer or solution. The prior 120-pose replays are from wall-floor-composition.json. ThroughBoth is the per-pose maximum of GPU-complete readback and marked framebuffer swap. Camera visibility overlaps lighting. Compositor scales the 4K framebuffer; monitor scanout is unmeasured. Memory counts instrumented engine and GPU payloads, excluding the JS runtime, driver and swap buffers.
roundedVisibility: whole interval certified by its extremes
timingNotes: Independent operator checks overlapped a portion of the initial one-slat replay. Its isolated repeat is retained. The first two-slat replay had a much longer readback-to-marked-swap interval than the earlier baseline. Paired runs remeasured both versions. Earlier development variants were profiled separately and some timings overlapped diagnostic work. Single-device wall times are observations, not guaranteed speedups.

roundedOutlineAudit.method: 1,024 finite source generators per radius with seed 324. Half are parallel to a local box axis. The other half use general orientations; the receiving plane is beyond the solid. Compare empty intervals, random interiors and both sides of their ends to an independently evaluated exactRoundedHit using rational segment and quadratic signs. epsilons in metres.

actualGpuCoefficientAudit.method: Crowded tick 30. Scan each weighted GPU result for negative components. Stratify by reduction, gap/width and tilt. Integrate each of four hats independently in receiver angles: x=sqrt(h²+y²)tan(phi), y=h*tan(theta). Integrate cos²(phi), sin(phi)cos(phi) and sin²(phi) analytically, then double the number of eight-point polar panels to 1e-12 absolute agreement. Report worst component in each nonempty stratum. Relative errors use total local mass.

rawEndpointOnly.decision: Rejected: cancellation caused physically impossible weights before sparse assembly.

axialDepthExtrema.decision: Rejected: the projected-depth extremum approach passed selected ray decisions but caused excessive outer refinement on the actual moving scene. It is absent from the playable solver.

normalEntryCheck.description: Final source tree on the normal room URL. Fresh solved and drawn 4K tick 30 in each population, followed by synchronisation. Counts, rule mix, summed incident light, maximum and residual equal the profiled candidate. Individual times here are spot checks.

receiverDomainOpportunity.description: Single-pose offline tally. Certify strictly facing, unoccluded pairs between lamp-dark planar source rectangles and planar receiver domains, beyond the two existing region modes. Count individual GPU jobs whose entire receiving domain passed this visibility proof. These are opportunities for shared evaluation. The proof alone does not integrate a field on that domain. Separately count incidence and distinct corners within each receiver row for the corner-primitive mode.
